title: 会飞的特斯拉，到底能飞多久？
title_en: The flying Tesla: how long can it really fly?

segments.zh: 这周，美国得州。一辆特斯拉跑车，头朝下，开过了一条倒挂的轨道。
segments.en: This week in Texas, a Tesla sports car drove upside down along an inverted track.

segments.zh: 翻个身，落地，再从五辆车的头顶上，一跳而过。
segments.en: It flipped, landed, and then jumped clean over five cars.

segments.zh: 先算个小账：五辆车排起来大约二十五米。斜着起跳，每秒十六米就够，相当于时速五十多公里。
segments.en: Quick math: five cars in a row are about 25 meters. Launch at an angle and 16 m/s is enough, about 56 km/h.

segments.zh: 在空中只待两秒多。这一跳难的不是距离，是落地别把车摔坏。
segments.en: That's just over two seconds in the air. The hard part isn't the distance. It's landing without wrecking the car.

segments.zh: 马斯克说：这就是将来量产的那辆车，二零二八年。
segments.en: Musk says this is the actual production car, coming in 2028.

segments.zh: 其实这辆车二零一七年就发布过，当时承诺：一点九秒破百，续航一千公里。
segments.en: This car was first unveiled in 2017, promising 0 to 60 in 1.9 seconds and 1,000 km of range.

segments.zh: 二零一八年马斯克又说，要给它加个 SpaceX 套件：车身一圈小喷口。今天，喷口真的来了。
segments.en: In 2018 Musk promised a SpaceX package: small thrusters around the body. Today, the thrusters showed up.

segments.zh: 三个黑科技：吸在天花板上、一秒破百、会飞。今天不站队，我们一个一个算账。
segments.en: Three tricks: sticking to the ceiling, 0 to 60 in a second, and flying. No sides today. We do the math.

segments.zh: 今天的主角：小 R，一辆有点紧张的跑车。
segments.en: Today's star: R, a slightly nervous sports car.

segments.zh: 黑科技一：倒着开，车重两吨，为什么掉不下来？
segments.en: Trick one: upside down, two tons of car. Why doesn't it fall?

segments.zh: 车底藏着几台风扇，拼命把车底的空气往外抽，车底气压变低。
segments.en: Fans hidden underneath pump air out from under the car, so the pressure there drops.

segments.zh: 而头顶上，是整个大气层：每平方米，压着十吨。
segments.en: Above it sits the whole atmosphere: ten tons on every square meter.

segments.zh: 车底大约八平方米，只要比外面低百分之五，就多出四吨的力，把车按住。
segments.en: The floor is about eight square meters. Just five percent lower pressure gives four tons pressing the car on.

segments.zh: 四吨按着两吨的车：倒过来，也掉不下去。
segments.en: Four tons holding a two-ton car: even upside down, it stays put.

segments.zh: 反过来说：风扇一停，四吨变零。倒挂开车的时候，风扇比轮子还要命。
segments.en: Flip side: if the fans stop, four tons becomes zero. Upside down, the fans matter more than the wheels.

segments.zh: 特斯拉屏幕上写的更猛：四千七百公斤，车重的两倍多。
segments.en: Tesla's screen claimed even more: 4,700 kg, over twice the car's weight.

segments.zh: 科技媒体说，这个数可能有水分。不过我们算的四吨，已经够用。
segments.en: Tech press suspect that's inflated. But our four tons is already enough.

segments.zh: 这招一点不新：一九七八年，F1 赛车 BT46B，屁股上装了个大风扇。
segments.en: And it isn't new: in 1978 the F1 car BT46B had a giant fan on its back.

segments.zh: 只比了一场，赢了。然后就被叫停：对手说它是吸尘器，还往后喷石子。
segments.en: It raced once and won. Then it was pulled: rivals called it a vacuum cleaner that sprayed stones.

segments.zh: 后来，F1 干脆禁了风扇车，一禁就是四十多年。
segments.en: F1 later banned fan cars outright, and the ban has lasted over forty years.

segments.zh: 风扇最狠的地方：机翼要靠速度才有下压力，风扇停着就有。
segments.en: Here's the killer feature: wings need speed for downforce. Fans work standing still.

segments.zh: 机翼的下压力跟速度的平方走：速度减半，只剩四分之一。
segments.en: Wing downforce goes with speed squared: half the speed, a quarter of the force.

segments.zh: 所以风扇车在弯道最占便宜：车速一慢，机翼没劲了，风扇照样吸。
segments.en: So fan cars shine in corners: when speed drops, wings go weak, but fans keep sucking.

segments.zh: 黑科技一，打分：真本事。
segments.en: Trick one gets a score: the real thing.

segments.zh: 黑科技二：零到六十英里，也就是九十六公里，一秒。
segments.en: Trick two: 0 to 60 miles an hour, that's 96 km/h, in one second.

segments.zh: 一秒钟加到每秒二十七米：加速度，二点七个 g。
segments.en: Reaching 27 meters per second in one second: that's 2.7 g.

segments.zh: 这一秒，只跑了十三米多，差不多三辆车那么长。
segments.en: In that one second it covers just over 13 meters, about three car lengths.

segments.zh: 对比一下：现在最快的量产电车，零到六十英里大约一点七秒；F1 赛车两秒半左右。
segments.en: For comparison: the fastest production EV does 0 to 60 in about 1.7 seconds; an F1 car in about 2.5.

segments.zh: 可车是靠轮胎抓地往前推的。最好的轮胎，也就一点几个 g。
segments.en: But a car pushes through its tires, and the best tires manage only 1-point-something g.

segments.zh: 第一招：风扇把车压紧。压得越紧，轮胎抓得越牢。
segments.en: Fix one: the fans press the car down. The harder the press, the better the grip.

segments.zh: 第二招更狠：干脆不靠地面，车尾向后喷气，就像火箭。
segments.en: Fix two, more brutal: forget the road. Blast gas out the back, like a rocket.

segments.zh: 据报道，后面四个喷口，推力约八万牛。
segments.en: Reportedly, the four rear jets make about 80,000 newtons.

segments.zh: 八万牛除以两吨，每秒提速四十米：四个 g。光靠喷气就够了。
segments.en: 80,000 newtons over two tons is 40 meters per second squared: 4 g. The jets alone are enough.

segments.zh: 但喷气只够喷一两秒，所以它是专门给起步那一下准备的。
segments.en: But the jets only last a second or two, so they're made for that one launch.

segments.zh: 不过，还没有独立测量。这个“一秒”，先打个问号。
segments.en: No independent test yet, though. That 'one second' gets a question mark.

segments.zh: 黑科技三，重头戏：它到底能飞多久？官方只给了两个数：十个喷口，六百升压缩空气。
segments.en: Trick three, the main event: how long can it fly? Tesla gave two numbers: ten jets, 600 liters of compressed air.

segments.zh: 六百升，就是三个浴缸。压到三百个大气压，大约装两百公斤空气；压到七百，也就三百多公斤。
segments.en: 600 liters is three bathtubs. At 300 atmospheres that's about 200 kg of air; at 700, just over 300.

segments.zh: 冷空气喷出去，每秒最多六七百米。推力八万牛，除一下：每秒要喷掉一百三十公斤。
segments.en: Cold air leaves at 600 to 700 meters per second at most. 80 kN divided by that: 130 kg every second.

segments.zh: 两百公斤，每秒一百三，一秒半见底。而且压力一掉，推力跟着掉。
segments.en: 200 kg at 130 per second: empty in a second and a half. And as pressure drops, so does thrust.

segments.zh: 只悬停呢？两吨的车要两万牛，每秒三十多公斤：五到十秒，就得落地。
segments.en: Just hovering? Two tons needs 20 kN, over 30 kg a second: down again in five to ten seconds.

segments.zh: 那为什么不喷火？火箭燃料喷速每秒三千米，是冷空气的五倍：同样的推力，只要五分之一的料。
segments.en: Why not use fire? Rocket exhaust leaves at 3,000 m/s, five times faster than cold air: same thrust, a fifth of the propellant.

segments.zh: 可车上烧火箭燃料，路边的人就不是被石子砸，是被烤了。所以只能喷冷气。
segments.en: But burn rocket fuel on a car, and bystanders don't get pelted with gravel. They get roasted. So: cold air.

segments.zh: 冷气推进其实很常见：卫星在太空里调姿态，喷的就是冷气。
segments.en: Cold-gas thrusters are actually common: satellites use them to adjust their attitude in space.

segments.zh: 不信？我们做了一个虚拟实验，你可以自己调。
segments.en: Don't believe us? We built a virtual lab. Try it yourself.

segments.zh: 三百个大气压，悬停三米：五秒左右。
segments.en: 300 atmospheres, hover at three meters: about five seconds.

segments.zh: 压到七百个大气压：十秒左右。
segments.en: Squeeze it to 700: about ten seconds.

segments.zh: 再把车减掉五百公斤：也就十二秒多。
segments.en: Then cut 500 kg off the car: just over twelve.

segments.zh: 注意：车减掉四分之一，时间只多了两秒多。瓶颈是罐子，不是车重。
segments.en: Notice: cut a quarter of the weight and you gain only two seconds. The bottleneck is the tank, not the car.

segments.zh: 还有隐藏减益：气体一膨胀就降温，罐子越喷越冷，压力掉得更快，喷口还会结霜。
segments.en: Hidden penalty: expanding gas cools, the tank gets colder, pressure falls faster, and nozzles frost.

segments.zh: 结论：这不是飞，是用两百公斤空气，换来的一次很贵的跳。
segments.en: Verdict: it doesn't fly. It trades 200 kg of air for one very expensive jump.

segments.zh: 不过，跳得有派头，也是真功夫：它在空中怎么翻跟头？
segments.en: Still, a stylish jump takes skill. How does it flip in mid-air?

segments.zh: 秘密是：喷口不对准重心。推力偏一点，就变成让车转动的力，叫力矩。
segments.en: The secret: the jets don't point through the center of mass. Off-center thrust turns the car. That's torque.

segments.zh: 力矩等于推力乘距离：假如偏一米，八万牛就是八万牛米，翻一辆车绰绰有余。
segments.en: Torque is thrust times distance: off by one meter, 80,000 newtons makes 80,000 newton-meters. Plenty to flip a car.

segments.zh: 前面喷、后面不喷，车头抬起来；左边喷、右边不喷，车就打滚。
segments.en: Fire the front but not the back, and the nose lifts. Fire the left but not the right, and it rolls.

segments.zh: 十个喷口一起配合，就能在空中“开”车。火箭回收落地，用的也是这一招。
segments.en: Ten jets together let it steer in the air. Rockets that land themselves use the same trick.

segments.zh: 再烧一点脑：同样托起两吨，直升机能在天上待一个小时，喷口为什么只能撑几秒？
segments.en: A brain-burner: a helicopter holds up two tons for an hour. Why do jets last only seconds?

segments.zh: 推力，是每秒喷出的空气乘速度；花的力气，却是空气乘速度的平方，再除以二。
segments.en: Thrust is air per second times speed. But the energy you spend is air times speed squared, over two.

segments.zh: 速度翻一倍，推力翻一倍，力气翻四倍。所以想省力：多推空气，推得慢一点。
segments.en: Double the speed: double the thrust, four times the energy. So to save energy, push more air, more slowly.

segments.zh: 喷口：每秒三十公斤空气，六百多米每秒，功率六千多千瓦。
segments.en: Jets: 30 kg of air a second at over 600 m/s. That's over 6,000 kilowatts.

segments.zh: 十米的旋翼：每秒推一吨空气，只要二十米每秒，约两百千瓦。
segments.en: A ten-meter rotor: a ton of air a second at just 20 m/s. About 200 kilowatts.

segments.zh: 差了三十倍。所以真正在做飞行汽车的公司，造出来的都长着螺旋桨。
segments.en: Thirty times apart. That's why companies building real flying cars all use propellers.

segments.zh: 无人机为什么都是大桨慢转？同一个道理：桨越大，越省电。
segments.en: Why do drones use big, slow propellers? Same reason: the bigger the blade, the less power.

segments.zh: 黑科技三，打分：物理没错，但它是表演，不是交通工具。
segments.en: Trick three gets a score: right physics, but a stunt, not transportation.

segments.zh: 好，假设你就坐在里面。起步四个 g，跟过山车最猛的那一下差不多。
segments.en: Now imagine you're inside. Launching at 4 g is like the wildest moment on a roller coaster.

segments.zh: 四个 g 的时候，你七十公斤的身体，压在座椅上有两百八十公斤。
segments.en: At 4 g, your 70 kg body presses into the seat like 280 kg.

segments.zh: 翻跟头时头朝下，血往脑袋里冲。科技媒体都在问：要不要穿战斗机飞行员的抗荷服？
segments.en: Upside down, blood rushes to your head. Tech press ask: will you need a fighter pilot's g-suit?

segments.zh: 车里每个空隙，都塞满了碳纤维缠绕的高压气罐，压力是轮胎的上百倍。
segments.en: Every gap inside is packed with carbon-fiber-wrapped tanks, at over a hundred times tire pressure.

segments.zh: 这种罐子又轻又结实，但 SpaceX 几次火箭出事，都和这类罐子有关。
segments.en: They're light and strong, but this type of tank has been linked to SpaceX rocket failures.

segments.zh: 还有路边的人：据报道，演示时喷气卷起的碎石沙子，能飞出几十米。
segments.en: And bystanders: reportedly the blast threw gravel and sand tens of meters during the demo.

segments.zh: 再算一笔账：把气罐充满，最理想也要二十多度电，够这辆车跑一百多公里。
segments.en: One more sum: filling the tanks takes, ideally, over 20 kWh. That would drive this car over 100 km.

segments.zh: 按家里的电价，一跳也就十几块钱。真正贵的，是那些罐子和风险。
segments.en: At household electricity prices, one jump costs a couple of dollars. The expensive part is the tanks and the risk.

segments.zh: 马斯克自己说：安全不是主要目标；他们会“争取不害死任何人”。
segments.en: Musk himself said safety is not the main goal, and they will 'aspire not to kill anyone'.

segments.zh: 这是原话，我们不加评论。
segments.en: Those are his words. No comment from us.

segments.zh: 好，打分表。
segments.en: OK, the scorecard.

segments.zh: 吸地：真本事，一九七八年就有，现在做得更猛。
segments.en: Suction: real, around since 1978, now turned up.

segments.zh: 一秒破百：物理上说得通，等独立测量。
segments.en: One-second sprint: physically plausible, awaiting independent tests.

segments.zh: 飞：几秒钟的表演。很酷，但别指望它带你上班。
segments.en: Flying: a few seconds of show. Cool, but it won't fly you to work.

segments.zh: 时间表：二零一七年就发布过，推迟了一次又一次，现在说二零二八年量产。
segments.en: Timeline: first unveiled in 2017, delayed again and again, now promised for 2028.

segments.zh: 对一下账：一点九秒变成了一秒，交车从二零二零年变成了二零二八年。
segments.en: Check the books: 1.9 seconds became 1, and delivery went from 2020 to 2028.

segments.zh: 最后一个彩蛋：马斯克说，也许会开着它飞越蛇河峡谷。
segments.en: One last easter egg: Musk said it might jump the Snake River Canyon.

segments.zh: 一九七四年，有个特技演员骑着火箭摩托试过：降落伞提前打开，他飘进了峡谷底。
segments.en: In 1974 a stuntman tried it on a rocket bike. His parachute opened early and he drifted into the canyon.

segments.zh: 要是小 R 真飞过去了，我们再做一期。
segments.en: If R actually makes it, we'll make another episode.

segments.zh: 下期见。小 R，别紧张，你今天表现不错。
segments.en: See you next time. Relax, R. You did great today.

segments.zh: 友情提示：吸力、一秒破百、六百升是特斯拉的说法；八万牛来自媒体报道；空气量、飞行时间、功率和电量，是我们按常见数值做的估算。
segments.en: Note: the suction, the one-second sprint and 600 liters are Tesla's claims; 80 kN is from press reports; air mass, airtime, power and energy are our estimates.
